# Dialog candidate qualification

This directory holds source compositions for the incremental Dialog adaptation.
S105 freezes types only. S106–S109 replace the named parts with actual candidate
wrappers while explicitly retaining raw Bits parts not yet authored. Owned
consumer copies check/build/render these compositions; the maintained fresh
fixture remains pristine. The family is not an installable registry item until
its source, types, exports and CSS form the complete S111 cohort.
